This category lists articles that flag an open question in the Star Wars CCG record: a result that sources disagree on, a document that was published but never preserved, or a person or event that no surviving source explains. The questions are written up, with their sources and what would settle them, on the [[Mysteries]] page.

Articles are added here by the inline template <code><nowiki>{{Mystery|question=…|section=…}}</nowiki></code>, placed at the spot in the article where the gap is (see [[Template:Mystery]] for how to use it). When a question is answered, the article is updated with the source, the flag is removed, and the entry moves to the [[Mysteries#Solved|Solved]] section of the Mysteries page.

If you can answer one of these, see [[Mysteries#How to help|How to help]].
